subject: Update script to generate Valkey Module API docs (#406)
reason: The change only modifies utils/generate-module-api-doc.rb, an offline Ruby script used to generate Module API documentation (renaming RM_/RedisModule_ patterns to VM_/ValkeyModule_ and sourcing the 'since' map from module-api-since.rb). It is a build/docs tooling change with no effect on valkey-server, valkey-cli, replication, persistence, or any command behavior, so no fuzzer scenario can reach it and none is needed.
